review_description: I found Electrical Masters the best company for installing solar panels and battery systems. In the past I had a small system and now we have installed 48 kw batteries for our house and it is great. Very professional and friendly staff and they do a big job in a very short time. I am happy with all the services they provide before and after the installation. Definitely 5 star from me.
Very happy with the entire process from sales till installation, will be recommending all my friends and family.

Electrical Masters recently designed and installed a new solar battery system for me and decommissioned my old system, and I couldn’t be happier with the entire experience.  From start to finish, their team was friendly, professional, polite, and incredibly supportive. They were always on time and remained patient and understanding- even when my neglected, overly messy garage caused delays on my end.I worked with Jay Lakota and one of my biggest reliefs was how he and his team handled all the government forms and paperwork it was an absolute godsend and took a huge weight of my shoulders.Having first commissioned solar in 2010 - a process that was a complete nightmare - I am beyond grateful that I chose Electrical Masters this time round. The difference in quality, communication and care was night and day.  I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy and capable team for their solar needs.

We're very happy that we used SolarQuotes to kick start our battery journey, it made the process so simple.  Three quotes from local installers, all were quick to make contact. Calls and quotes the following day, we then did further research with links and more information they provided. Over the weekend we decided to change what we wanted, we sent emails to the installers and they quickly provided updated quotes.  Quotes accepted one day and battery installed the next. Installers were very professional and polite, after install they helped explain how the system worked and setting up the App. Tidied up afterwards. Very happy with result.

The team where friendly, informative and know the solar market well compared to a lot of retailers who are just there for the sale. The installation team were great and even managed to turn around the inspection before go-live very quickly!
Very good service and price was great as well as the quick turn around thanks you so much guys.
A bit more notice before installation  would have been nice.Pestered to leave a review even before battery was turned on !!!

The quote process was easy and quick with quotes provided efficiently. The team were very punctual, very polite and helpful with site assessment and discussing the viable options for installation of battery. The team members were experts in their specialism and provided indepth information about the use and installation. We highly recommend the agency for their expertise in the field, punctuality and making us at ease during the whole process.

The sale and quoting process was smooth. Electrical Masters offered a very competitive price for the battery installation. The installation team was knowledgeable and punctual . The work was tidy with clear labels for the system.The customer service was good with regular updates. Jay Lalit offered good customer service and coordinated the whole process. Ali offered technical advice for the installation.The grid connection was organised within a week of installation. The company assisted with the grid connection.

If you’re reading this review because you’re considering the services of Electrical Masters, then my opinion is that you would definitely be impressed with what this company offers.I recently decided to purchase a storage battery and whilst I knew the basics, there was a lot that I didn’t know but wanted to be informed about. I’d previously used SolarQuotes for my Solar panels and that was a good experience, so was confident that they would be able to refer me to 3 trustworthy retailers – an important consideration given that there will be plenty of cowboys with inferior products out there trying to take advantage of the Government Battery Rebate Scheme.Referral led me to Electrical Masters who responded within hours of me requesting a quote. First contact was from Jas who explained the whole process, went into depth on what the various batteries are capable of, asked me what we wanted to achieve and what our goals were. Importantly, through his explanations he was able to provoke questions from me that consequently gave me a great understanding of the product and process, including the finer details of location of unit and installation. Being better informed and between Jas and I, we were able to decide on what the best option would be for us. Jas’ knowledge of their products and his ability to communicate and empathise were first class and gave me the confidence to know I was dealing with the right people. I was given a very competitive quote on the day and after speaking with the other Retailers was very comfortable with my decision to go with Electrical Masters.Following on from this, I received a site visit from Ricky, the company owner, to discuss Battery location – I’d had a possible change of thought. After discussion location was decided on. Through additional discussion, I was extremely impressed with Ricky’s attitude to his business, staff and products, which again reinforced my confidence that I’d made the right decision.Installation time was arranged very quickly (timing is everything!) and Installers Jaswinder and Harry arrived on site as expected and did excellent installation job, cleaned up and removed all packaging and mess. The boys were very friendly, ensured the system was up and running and connected to both Manufacturer’s and my Home’s Networks. They took the time to show me how the App works and whilst I’m still getting a handle on my battery’s capabilities, confidence is growing within days.I purchased a Sigenergy SigenStor  24kWh Battery and highly recommend it and Electrical Masters the Supplier.

I couldn't be happier with our recent solar and battery installation from Electrical Masters. The entire process was seamless, professional, and delivered exceptional results.A huge shout-out to the installation team:Daniel & Team did an amazing job installing the panels. He ensured we achieved the maximum possible installation on the roof space, which is already translating into fantastic performance. His work ethic and attention to detail were first-rate.Beau's professionalism was outstanding during the installation of the battery and gateway. His neatness, knowledge, and dedication to ensuring everything was commissioned perfectly was truly impressive.It's clear that the Electrical Masters team takes great pride in their work. Highly recommend them for a top-quality system and a stress-free installation!

I struggled to get someone to come out and view the property. Electrical masters sent someone. They helped choose the best place for the battery that worked for me and satisfied regulations. They adjusted as I learnt and worked to my needs. Price was best by far, grid connected and they answer the phone when I call. Not much more to add.

Electrical Masters provided a well designed battery solution including a gateway to allow full operation of the system in off-grid mode.The quote provided was signficantly cheaper then others for exactly the same equipment.There was a reasonable delay between deposit and installation but this was due to supply of battery components rather than installers.The installers were on time and the installation was very neat and the site was left tidy afterwards. Intially there was a compatibility issue between the existing soalr panel inverter (SolarEdge) and the new battery system (SigEnergy). Electrical Masters spoke to both technical teams and were able to resolve the issue within 48 hours. The SigEnergy app is brilliant and gives your full visibility and control over the system operation.I'd highly recommend Electrical Masters as a battery system installer.

I recently had Electrical Masters install a home battery system. Their initial pricing wasn’t the clearest, but they were open to negotiation and I was able to secure a very good deal in the end.The installation itself was quick and efficient, though I did have to step in and clarify parts of the quoted scope with the installers on the day. To their credit, once those details were confirmed, the team got on with the job and delivered the system as promised. A small fault cropped up shortly after commissioning, but their support team responded promptly and had it resolved the next business day.Overall, Electrical Masters delivered a very good deal, fast installation, and excellent fault resolution. While there’s room for improvement in communication between quoting and installation, I’d still highly recommend them to others considering a home battery system.

Electrical Masters can be trusted. I got the best quote in town that came with top/good quality solar panels and battery. They accomodate to my request for delay in installation for about a month. The solar panels were upgraded without additional cost when the solar panel company rolled out the latest all black panels before the installation. The installation team especially the technician head were polite and efficient.Can’t wait for the inspection to be done (system installed yesterday) and start to see the savings in my energy bill.

Electrical Masters recently installed a solar battery system at my home, and the whole process—from quote to installation—was very fast and smooth. The installation team were professional and took the time to ensure the site was suitable and the job was done neatly. Communication with Electrical Masters was easy throughout. I’m very happy with the quality of their work and the overall experience. Highly recommended!
Good process, was a little long all things said and done, but most of this was resulting from initial delays on my end. Great customer service and strong follow ups.

Had Electrical Masters install my Sigenergy battery system. The installation was finished nicely and clean, and I’m happy with the result. Jass from the sales team was very helpful and patient with all my questions. Internal communication could be smoother, but overall it was a good experience.

I had a great experience with The Electrical Masters from start to finish. Jay explained the system options clearly and made sure it was tailored to my needs. When the original battery wasn’t available, they organised an alternative at a similar price. The installation team was polite, on time, and left everything neat and tidy. They showed me how to configure the mobile app, however I am still waiting for the grid connection to be completed. In all, couldn’t have asked for better service.

I had a 6.6kW solar system installed by Electrical Masters last month, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience.From the start, the team explained the system clearly and answered all my questions without any pressure. The quoting process was transparent and easy to understand.The installation itself was done professionally and on time. The installers were friendly, efficient, and left the site clean and tidy. Since installation, everything has worked exactly as expected. I've been able to track the system’s performance easily, and it's already making a noticeable difference to our energy usage. I would highly recommend Electrical Masters to anyone considering solar – professional, knowledgeable, and a pleasure to deal with from start to finish.
Entire process was amazing, I’m enjoying the product to the max. Thanks Electrical Masters for a complete package, good customer service and high levels of professionalism

Terrific service from admin side to the installing side, communication was spot on and even the prices were good.I recommend Electrical Masters for all your solar and battery needs.Thanks again Electrical Masters for installing my solar and looking after me.
Quick and nice installationFriendly and helpful staffMuch recommended
Had a very smooth and quick process to install solar panels for my home. Good customer service .
The sales consultant answered all my queries. Their quote was way better than 3 to 4 providers I compared.

Communication during installation and completion could be improved. It should not be left to the homeowner to make calls to find out if the workers were turning up or not, There should be one case manager who is aware the progress and payment.Otherwise, the units were installed by efficient workers and electrician and so far, unit and battery is functioning as required.
